newsitem.title: UK: UK's Gartmore to outsource Bank of NY services.
newsitem.headline: UK's Gartmore to outsource Bank of NY services.

text.p: The Bank of New York said on Thursday it had agreed with UK's Gartmore Investment Management to provide custody services to Gartmore's clients.

The Bank of New York said the outsourcing will involve custody services for 25 billion stg of assets for about 300 Gartmore clients, representing the largest ever outsourcing to a single custodian in the UK.

"This outsourcing arrangement will allow us to focus on our core investment management strengths, while ensuring that out clients receive efficient, value added custody services," Gartmore's chief executive Andrew Brown said.
